annotations.title: NY average weekly wage with tips, board and concurrent wages

description: The average weekly wage the way the Pro Workspace's global AWW works it out: earnings_method "steady" (earnings ÷ days worked × the 200/260/300/365 multiplier for a 4-/5-/6-/7-day week ÷ 52) or "irregular" (earnings ÷ weeks worked), plus weekly tips, the weekly value of board, and a concurrent employer's weekly wage. With a date of accident it adds the two-thirds weekly rate within the max and min. For a 1–3 day week use calculate_aww. New York State only. Computes with The Comp Desk calc-core, the same engine as the app and the Pro Workspace; it never estimates. A missing input returns status "missing" and nothing is calculated. Returns the figures, the steps with the rule and engine function behind each, and the not-legal-advice notice.

concurrent_weekly_wage.description: Optional: weekly wage from a concurrent employer, in dollars.

date_of_accident.description: Optional: adds the weekly rate. YYYY-MM-DD.

days_per_week.description: steady: days normally worked each week.

days_worked.description: steady: days actually worked in the period.

total_earnings.description: Gross earnings in the period, in dollars.

weekly_board.description: Optional: weekly value of board/lodging, in dollars.
